notes.sowing: Sow indoors 3 to 4 weeks before planting out, two seeds per pot {cm:1.5} deep, at {c:21} to {c:32}. Plant out 2 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:18} and nights stay above {c:12}. Or sow outdoors once the soil is that warm.
notes.care: Black plastic mulch and a row cover help in cool summers; lift the cover when flowers open so bees can reach them. Water evenly at the base until fruit is full sized, then ease off. Vines can trail or climb a strong support.
notes.harvest: Cantaloupes are ripe when the netting coarsens, the skin turns from green to tan or yellow, and the fruit slips off with a gentle twist. Smooth melons smell sweet and give slightly at the blossom end.
